decisions.summary: Census walks only projects named -diagram or beginning -diagram- (the mirror and its clones), agent type from the meta's agentType, ROOT= override for the test.
decisions.why: FR-001 asks for every subagent transcript whose project is this repository or one of its clones; clone project dirs begin -diagram-.

decisions.summary: Usage folded per message.id as the per-field maximum; the model read from message.model, not from the dispatch override.
decisions.why: FR-001 states both rules; R2 records the why and the rejected alternative.

decisions.summary: Census columns add per-run means and a models tally, plus an ad-hoc block for agent types with no file under .claude/agents/ - how many runs carried no dispatch model and which models they ran on, Fable named.
decisions.why: FR-010 requires R1 to record how many past ad-hoc runs inherited and on which model; round 2's aside asked for Fable specifically.

decisions.summary: SINCE= filters on the transcript's first timestamp.
decisions.why: FR-001 offers SINCE=YYYY-MM-DD and leaves its semantics open; this is inside it.

decisions.summary: _quote_verbatim.py is three pure stages (footnotes, visible_text, verdict) with an --offline DIR fixture mode so the test needs no network.
decisions.why: Implementation shape for FR-003 plus SC-002's fixture test; adds no behavior the spec did not ask for.

decisions.summary: Decoding order: HTTP header, then meta charset, then utf-8, then shift_jis; NOT-CHECKED when none decodes cleanly.
decisions.why: FR-003 asks for the declared or sniffed encoding honored with Shift_JIS read correctly, and NOT-CHECKED with why for an undecodable page.

decisions.summary: DIFFERS is chosen over NOT-ON-PAGE by difflib.SequenceMatcher over a sliding window at the passage's length, best ratio 0.85 or more.
decisions.why: FR-003 names both verdicts but not how to tell them apart. The threshold only picks which of two FAILING words is printed, both go to the session, and no passage passes by it.

decisions.summary: Fetch policy: one urlopen per distinct URL, 20 s timeout, a browser user agent, one attempt per HOST per run with later URLs on a refused host UNFETCHABLE without a request, PDF content type or path NOT-CHECKED.
decisions.why: FR-003 asks for one fetch per distinct link, one attempt per host, a bounded timeout, a refused host never retried, and a PDF as NOT-CHECKED.

decisions.summary: A passage carrying an elision (... or [...]) is matched piece by piece in order rather than as one substring.
decisions.why: FR-003's exactness clause governs NORMALIZATION (a hyphen for a dash, a spelling), and every fragment is still matched exactly with none. An elided excerpt is several quoted fragments, and a literal one-substring rule would report every correctly elided footnote NOT-ON-PAGE. Residual risk, noted not ruled: order-only matching cannot see text wrongly dropped at the elision.

decisions.summary: For a marked translation the ORIGINAL is what is matched against the page; the entry carries both so the agent judges the translation.
decisions.why: The spec's edge case and FR-004 say exactly this.

decisions.summary: quote-check's Procedure step 2 takes the script's Readability and Quotation verdicts as given and fetches only the UNFETCHABLE and NOT-CHECKED residue; verdict vocabulary and Output untouched; the run-the-script-first rule goes in research/CLAUDE.md, root CLAUDE.md and docs/research-doctrine.md.
decisions.why: FR-004 names the behavior, the unchanged output format and those three documents.

decisions.summary: Pre-pass imports visible_text from the verbatim script, splits sections on h2/h3, uses a (label, regex) table for session notes, and takes vocabulary candidates as CJK runs, <i>/<em> spans and capitalized Latin binomials, each dropped when glossary.json holds it as a term or variant.
decisions.why: FR-005's pattern list is covered item for item. The markup test covers FR-005's 'italicized or romanized term' in this record as it is actually written - the research pages carry no at all and mark romanized terms in (for example tameike), which this review checked.

decisions.summary: Size table: rects at 3 px = 1 ft honoring a parent translate with other transforms flagged 'transform not applied'; collinear wall segments taken as sharing an axis within 1 px; label = nearest <text> by center distance with the distance printed.
decisions.why: FR-006 asks for rects, collinear wall gaps, stroke widths, the 3 px = 1 ft conversion and the nearest label; the flags disclose a limit rather than dropping a row, and the agent still checks the table against the sheet.

decisions.summary: Tier test shape: a TIERS dict, FR-002's five assertions as separate tests plus a non-vacuity count; test_entry_owed.py's model: opus assertion for entry-drift is left in place with its message pointed at the tier table.
decisions.why: FR-002 asks for the table and the assertions; entry-drift stays opus so the older assertion remains true and contradicts nothing.

decisions.summary: spec-fidelity-verify frontmatter: opus, medium, tools Read, Grep, Bash; body = MODE 3, FIGURES, the round-limit note and 'What you do NOT do'.
decisions.why: FR-008 asks for Opus, medium, the same tools and exactly those sections; spec-fidelity.md's own frontmatter reads 'tools: Read, Grep, Bash', which this review checked.

decisions.summary: spec-fidelity.md's MODE 3 shrinks to a pointer to the twin plus the hand-dispatch case.
decisions.why: FR-008 keeps MODE 3 in spec-fidelity as a pointer, and the spec's edge case contemplates a hand dispatch when the no-snapshot branch does not rewrite. A one-line hand-dispatch note is inside that; a second copy of MODE 3 would not be.

decisions.summary: Waist handling: AGENTS/TWIN in _hm_review_round.py with the rewrite branch setting subagent_type, the guard header, new hook test cases, the authorized list and the settings matcher CHANGED; plan-verdict and _plan_gate.py keep AS=spec-fidelity, and review-gate.sh, escalation, pair, prereq, discard and spec-lint recorded as not keyed on the type.
decisions.why: FR-008 asks for exactly this enumeration with each item changed or recorded, and the twin carries nothing of MODE 4, so the plan reviewer's declaration staying spec-fidelity follows from the spec.

decisions.summary: R4 does not verify whether the harness honors a changed subagent_type in updatedInput. The plan implements the type rewrite anyway and defers the proof to T07, reading this feature's own next later round's transcript meta, with the spec's fallback applied only if that round shows it did not route.
decisions.why: The accepted spec settles this the other way: 'plan.md verifies this before FR-008 relies on it, and if it cannot, the hook instead prepends the instruction and the session re-dispatches - recorded as the fallback'. The plan does neither. It is not impossible to verify: the installed 2.1.278 executable is greppable, and this review found 114 lines carrying updatedInput and 54 carrying subagent_type in it, including the operator message 'updatedInput is missing or empty, falling back to original tool input' and a tengu_subagent_type_normalized event - the same method R6 used to settle the effort frontmatter question. The deferral also rests on an event the feature does not control: the spec is already accepted and a MODE 4 plan review is not rewritten by the hook, so this feature may dispatch no later round at all, and FR-008's routing would land neither proven nor fallen back. Nothing in request.md implies the deferral. Fix: record the verification in R4 before T07 - the binary read, or a probe dispatch whose transcript meta names the agent that ran - or adopt the spec's recorded fallback.

decisions.summary: Seeded-fault runs: artifacts materialized under the scratchpad with git show so the tree does not change; six downgraded agents x three artifacts = eighteen runs, one artifact per agent, background, tokens from make agent-census SINCE=.
decisions.why: FR-011 asks for at least two known-finding artifacts and one known-clean per downgraded agent, one artifact per agent, in the background, with tokens beside the recorded per-run mean.

decisions.summary: Record updates per FR-012 plus ## [project] help lines on the new make targets so test_make_docs.py sees them.
decisions.why: FR-012 asks for the documents and that every new make target is listed where the others are.

decisions.summary: Order T01 census first through T10 land; R1 may reorder T03-T07 but may not remove one.
decisions.why: FR-001 makes the census task zero whose result may reorder the work, and FR-009 keeps the approved pieces in.

decisions.summary: Every task is research: rendering; the delta takes the DIRECT route.
decisions.why: The spec says nothing here is engine code and takes the DIRECT route; no physical question is decided.
